en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a harbor with a large passenger steamship in the foreground moving through calm water, leaving ripples behind. Smoke rises from its funnel. Along the left shoreline are smaller boats and masts, with warehouses, houses, and industrial buildings of a town in the background. The scene is labeled at the bottom in Swedish, and publisher information appears in the lower right corner.
